subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Scanty
solution: The correct answer is **"Abundant."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Scanty** means small or insufficient. (संख्‍या या मात्रा में बहुत कम; अत्‍यल्‍प) • **Example:** *The dancers wore **scanty**__ costumes.* • **Abundant** means plentiful or ample. (प्रचुर या भरपूर) __ • **Example**: *I need an **abundant**__ supply of coffee in the morning* • Therefore, they are antonyms. • The prefix **"scant" **means lacking or inadequate, while the prefix **"ab-"** means excessive or plentiful. • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Meagre (Option 1)** means very small or inadequate, similar to scanty. (बहुत कम, स्‍वल्‍प) • **Divine (Option 3) **means related to or coming from God or a higher power, and is not related to the meaning of scanty. (दिव्‍य, दैवी, ईश्‍वरीय) • **Buoyant (Option 4) **means able to float or stay afloat, and is not related to the meaning of scanty. ((पदार्थ) उतराता हुआ या उतरा सकने वाला (वस्‍तु), तरणशील) 3d:Tc77, The correct answer is** "surround."**
